{"inp":{"code":"# Calculations for ELECTRO ACO ALTONA (EALT4) based on provided row 165 data
patrimonio_liq = 332505000.0
vpa = 14.910538
preco = 11.45
divida_liquida = 85926000.0
ebit = 78248000.0
lpa = 3.645650

# compute number of shares (float)
shares = patrimonio_liq / vpa
market_cap = preco * shares
ev_current = market_cap + divida_liquida

# implied prices
price_pvp1 = vpa  # P/VP = 1x

# EV/EBIT method for multiples 5x and 6x
ev_5 = 5 * ebit
marketcap_ev5 = ev_5 - divida_liquida
price_ev5 = marketcap_ev5 / shares

ev_6 = 6 * ebit
marketcap_ev6 = ev_6 - divida_liquida
price_ev6 = marketcap_ev6 / shares

# P/L methods
price_pl4 = lpa * 4
price_pl5 = lpa * 5
price_pl6 = lpa * 6

shares, market_cap, ev_current, price_pvp1, price_ev5, price_ev6, price_pl4, price_pl5, price_pl6
print('shares', shares)
print('market_cap', market_cap)
print('ev_current', ev_current)
print('P/VP=1 price', price_pvp1)
print('EV/EBIT 5x price', price_ev5)
print('EV/EBIT 6x price', price_ev6)
print('P/L 4x price', price_pl4)
print('P/L 5x price', price_pl5)
print('P/L 6x price', price_pl6)

# Also compute blended target: weights e.g. 30% P/VP, 40% EV/EBIT(5x), 30% P/L(4x) as used earlier
blend = 0.30*price_pvp1 + 0.40*price_ev5 + 0.30*price_pl4
blend
print('blend_target', blend)
"}}
